about.value: Bob & Harriet's Home bar is a neighborhood pub- serving seasonal New American cuisine in the east Atlanta neighborhood of Kirkwood just nextdoor to Decatur - weekend brunch, trivia, karaoke, sports bar, wings, burgers, beer, cocktails, darts, video games & more!
